scope.instruction: Trace the node insert/split helper 0x4c49f90 end to end: its argument contract, and on every path (non-full insert, leaf split, split propagation, root split, duplicate or error paths) whether and where the forwarded slab slot index (rdx, plus a copy in the context record at rcx) is written as a node key -- and whether forward_2's unconditional handle-total increment after the call can diverge from an actual store.  Secondary: whether the caller lookup callees 0x4da81b0 / 0x4da7880 are the forward-1 map readback.

extra_helper_1.note: structural twin of forward_2 with the identical helper argument setup; the values it passes are not traced

extra_helper_2.note: structural twin of forward_2 with the identical helper argument setup; the values it passes are not traced

alloc.via: slot 0x64df480, called from the helper at 0x4c4a062 (0x68 bytes), 0x4c4a1e5 and 0x4c4a415 (0xc8 bytes)

alloc_fail.via: slot 0x64df490, called from the helper at 0x4c4a652, 0x4c4a696 and 0x4c4a6b3 after a null allocation result

capacity_panic.via: slot 0x64df570, called from the helper at 0x4c4a608, 0x4c4a624 and 0x4c4a684 with a node key count at or above the 0xb/0xc bound

panic.via: slot 0x64df730, called from the helper at 0x4c4a642, 0x4c4a66b, 0x4c4a6dd and 0x4c4a6f6 on consistency-check failures

root_assert.via: slot 0x64df830, called from the helper at 0x4c4a6a3 and 0x4c4a6c2 (null root / null split node at the root split)

cleanup.via: slot 0x64df4a0, called from the helper at 0x4c4a706 (root-assert tail) and 0x4c4a729 (landing pad) to release a fresh node

lookup_panic.via: slot 0x64df770, called from lookup_a at 0x4da8382 and lookup_b at 0x4da7a52 on an out-of-range element index

argument_contract.rdi: the out record pointer (saved at 0x4c4a008 on the split path; written once by the shared epilogue)
argument_contract.rsi: the cursor record: {+0x0: leaf node, +0x8: 0, +0x10: insertion position} (read at 0x4c49fa1, 0x4c4a000, 0x4c49ff7 and 0x4c4a054; never written through)
argument_contract.rdx: the slab slot index forwarded by forward_2
argument_contract.rcx: the context record: {+0x0: sorted-set handle, +0x8: the index again, +0x10: leaf node, +0x18: 0, +0x20: position} (saved at 0x4c4a00d; only +0x0 is ever read, at the root split)
argument_contract.r8: a duplicate of the cursor record pointer (set at forward_2 0x51d1c13); never read by the helper before it is overwritten

caller_setup.form: after the call, forward_2 reloads the handle and jumps to its shared total increment (0x51d1bcf); the helper return value and out record are discarded
caller_setup.other_callers_form: two 351-byte structural twins of forward_2 (0x51d4920, 0x51d4a80) call the helper with the instruction-identical setup; the values they pass are not traced

capture.rewrite_form: after the leaf-level store, r12 is rewritten to a node pointer at 0x4c4a1f4 (parent split) and 0x4c4a3fb (root split), picked as an insert target at 0x4c4a2c5, and reused as a fixup-loop counter from 0x4c4a4a3; every later read uses one of those values
capture.duplicate_check: no instruction compares the captured index against a node key; the helper has no duplicate path and trusts the caller's cursor position and counts

node_layout.plus_0x0: parent node pointer (0 at the root)
node_layout.keys: sorted qword keys from node+0x8, at most 11
node_layout.child_index_word: node+0x60: this node's index in its parent's child array

fast_path.gate: key count (word at node+0x62, loaded at 0x4c49fa4) below 0xb at 0x4c49fa8/0x4c49fac
fast_path.shift: memmove (slot 0x64df568, call at 0x4c49fdd) moves keys[position..count) one slot up when position+1 <= count
fast_path.store_form: mov QWORD PTR [rbp+rax*8+0x8], r12 -- the index becomes the key at node+0x8+position*8
fast_path.exit: jmp 0x4c4a5da (0x4c49ffb), entering the epilogue past the out-field reloads with rax = position and rcx = [cursor+0x8]

leaf_split.split_points: separator index S and target by insertion position P: P < 5 -> S = 4, insert into the old node at P; P = 5 -> S = 5, old node at 5; P = 6 -> S = 5, new node at 0; P >= 7 -> S = 6, new node at P-7
leaf_split.alloc: a fresh 0x68-byte node via slot 0x64df480 at 0x4c4a062; a null result diverts to the allocation-failure blocks (slot 0x64df490) and the ud2 terminal
leaf_split.new_node_count: count-S-1 (computed by the not/add idiom at 0x4c4a085/0x4c4a088/0x4c4a08b, stored at 0x4c4a08e); a count of 0xc or more diverts to the capacity panic (slot 0x64df570)
leaf_split.key_copy: memcpy (slot 0x64df508, call at 0x4c4a0b5) copies keys[S+1..count) into the new node; the separator keys[S] is loaded into r13 at 0x4c4a09d
leaf_split.old_node_count: S, stored at 0x4c4a0bb before the insert
leaf_split.target_pick: cmove at 0x4c4a0c7 selects the old node (rbp) or the new node (r15) as rcx
leaf_split.store_form: mov QWORD PTR [rcx+rax*8+0x8], r12 -- the index becomes the key at target+0x8+position*8, before any propagation
leaf_split.memmove: slot 0x64df568, call at 0x4c4a108, shifts the target tail when its count exceeds the position

propagation.form: after the leaf store, the separator key (never the index) is inserted into the parent; a full parent (count >= 0xb) is split the same way -- fresh 0xc8 node via slot 0x64df480 at 0x4c4a1e5, keys and children copied via slot 0x64df508 at 0x4c4a245/0x4c4a28d -- and the loop at 0x4c4a140 climbs; the level counter seeded from [cursor+0x8] is incremented once per split level (0x4c4a273)
propagation.precondition: the propagation head panics (slot 0x64df730 at 0x4c4a642) if the level counter seed is nonzero on the first climb -- unreachable from forward_2, whose cursor+0x8 is 0 -- but only after the leaf store has executed

root_split.entry: the split node's parent pointer is 0 (leaf-as-root via 0x4c4a3ea, or the climb reaches the root)
root_split.context_use: the saved context record pointer ([rsp+0x50], stored at 0x4c4a00d) is read at 0x4c4a3f3; record+0x0 is the handle
root_split.asserts: a null current root (slot 0x64df830 at 0x4c4a6a3), a null split node (0x4c4a6c2), a level counter unequal to the handle height (slot 0x64df730 at 0x4c4a6dd) and a new-root count at or above 0xb (0x4c4a6f6) all abort; none returns
root_split.alloc: a fresh 0xc8-byte root via slot 0x64df480 at 0x4c4a415
root_split.form: the new root receives exactly one key -- the separator -- and two children; the handle root and height are updated in place

exits.epilogue_form: [out] = rbp, [out+0x8] = rcx, [out+0x10] = rax at 0x4c4a5da/0x4c4a5dd/0x4c4a5e1; rax = rdi at 0x4c4a5e5; on the fast path the record is {node, [cursor+0x8], position}
exits.unreachable_form: the two _Unwind_Resume landing pads (0x4c4a710--0x4c4a732, cleanup via slot 0x64df4a0) are LSDA-only; the remaining unreachable instructions are three NOP alignment pads (0x4c4a13a, 0x4c4a19a, 0x4c4a57e) and the second pad ud2 at 0x4c4a70e

node_insert.context_record_fate: saved once (0x4c4a00d), read once (0x4c4a3f3, field +0x0 only); never written through; its +0x8 copy of the index is never read -- the index comes from rdx
node_insert.cursor_record_fate: read-only: fields +0x0, +0x8 and +0x10; no store through rsi exists in the body

every_path_store_proof.method: instruction-level control-flow graph over the 473 decoded instructions; with the two index store instructions removed, neither the epilogue entry 0x4c4a5da nor the single ret 0x4c4a5f6 is reachable from the entry; calls are modelled as fall-through, and every reachable non-returning terminal is a ud2 behind a panic or allocation-failure block

node_insert.verdict: no divergence: the index is stored as a node key on every path that returns; forward_2's unconditional total increment is matched by a store on every returning path

fast_path.form: when dword [rdi] == 1 and [rdi+0x8] is nonzero (or after the materialisation call returns a base), returns [rdi+0x8] + [rdi+0x18]*0x58 + 0x8 -- an element pointer, not a stored value

slow_path.form: otherwise a descriptor is built from the record (fields +0x20.. and the dwords at +0x34/+0x3c) and passed to a materialisation call; the result is indexed at a 0x70 stride with the element at +0x18, after a bounds check against the array count that aborts via slot 0x64df770

call_census.form: a shared container accessor: each RE-006 caller calls its lookup four times, and further FDEs call it too; the site traced by the twin-caller packet is the one whose result feeds forward_2

lookup_a.verdict: not the forward-1 map readback: an array element resolver (0x58/0x70 strides), with no scrambled-hash probe

fast_path.form: when dword [rdi] == 1 and [rdi+0x8] is nonzero (or after the materialisation call returns a base), returns [rdi+0x8] + [rdi+0x18]*0x58 + 0x8 -- an element pointer, not a stored value

slow_path.form: otherwise a descriptor is built from the record (fields +0x20.. and the dwords at +0x34/+0x3c) and passed to a materialisation call; the result is indexed at a 0x70 stride with the element at +0x18, after a bounds check against the array count that aborts via slot 0x64df770

call_census.form: a shared container accessor: each RE-006 caller calls its lookup four times, and further FDEs call it too; the site traced by the twin-caller packet is the one whose result feeds forward_2

lookup_b.verdict: not the forward-1 map readback: an array element resolver (0x58/0x70 strides), with no scrambled-hash probe
